title: Morning rush in Kuala Lumpur: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Kuala Lumpur, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday. The feed has no route shapes for the long-distance ETS and airport ERT trains, so they are left out.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Kuala Lumpur city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Kelana Jaya, Ampang lines, Kajang, Putrajaya, Monorail and KTM, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 109 trains at 8:37 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
